rationale: Already in accumulated vocabulary as untranslated. Recurs here in line 2 in a damaged context. Greek παράφωνον 'discordant' or related; preserved untranslated until further parallels clarify the sense.
Lycopolitan verbal compound ⲣ̄-ϩⲱⲃ 'do work' with vowel-doubling and ϩ-loss. Used in line 3 'labor in the Spirit' as the activity required of the disciples. Standard Coptic with dialectal phonology.

Tentative agricultural compound: ⲕⲁϩ 'land' + ⲛⲟⲩϩⲉ likely a verbal noun for 'casting/sowing' (cf. ⲛⲟⲩϫⲉ 'throw, cast'). The fruit-harvest metaphor of the closing kephalaion supports a sowing/planting reading. Confidence low.
Lycopolitan idiom paralleling Sahidic ϣϣⲉ 'it is fitting/right.' The vowel-shift ϣⲱⲟⲉ for ϣϣⲉ is dialectal. Standard deontic construction in paraenesis.

proposed_english: the three begettings of the flesh
rationale: Chapter-heading technical compound: ⲱⲁⲙⲧ/ϣⲁⲙⲧ 'three' + ⲭⲡⲟ 'begetting' + ⲧⲥⲁⲣⲝ 'the flesh.' Names a Manichaean tripartite anthropological taxonomy: (1) begetting through union with abortions, (2) begetting in abortions, (3) self-molding.
